title: A credential claim should say exactly what the evidence can support.
summary: The claim, evidence-class, status, date, scope, ownership, and change controls applied to public education, role, publication, and affiliation statements about RN Collins and Aloha AI.
audience: Visitors, clients, partners, learners, institutions, and reviewers evaluating the qualifications or affiliations stated on Aloha AI.
policyOwner: Aloha AI, a DBA of Rayven-Nikkita Collins LLC · Honolulu, HI

releaseReview.nextReviewOrTrigger: 2026-11-02 or any education, enrollment, role, affiliation, publication, licensure, certification, name, evidence, status, or public-copy change

policySections.title: Exact-claim rule
paragraphs: A degree, enrollment, role, publication, fellowship, license, certification, membership, or institutional affiliation is published only at the level recorded in the register. Similar labels are not interchangeable: enrolled is not graduated; contributed to is not employed by; published by is not peer reviewed; used a vendor tool is not endorsed or certified by that vendor.

policySections.title: Evidence classes
paragraphs: Person-specific institutional records, an institution's public directory or verification, official program information, and independent public corroboration answer different questions. A program page can establish that a program exists; it does not establish that a named person enrolled or graduated. A third-party biography can corroborate a claim; it is not an institution-issued record. Private records are not published merely to make a public claim more persuasive.

policySections.title: Current and historical status
paragraphs: Current enrollment, employment, appointment, license, and membership claims require a status date and a recheck trigger. Historical experience is described as historical. Expected graduation years are projections, not awarded credentials. No site language may turn a candidate status into a completed degree or a past contribution into a current institutional appointment.

policySections.title: No endorsement or institutional voice
paragraphs: Naming a school, publisher, employer, client, vendor, or program identifies the bounded relationship only. It does not imply sponsorship, endorsement, partnership, approval, authorization to speak for the institution, or institutional review of Aloha AI. Marks and names remain subject to the Rights and Attribution policy.

policySections.title: Aloha AI learning records
paragraphs: Aloha AI University completion marks, downloads, assessments, portfolios, and browser-local records are self-records unless a resource expressly states otherwise. They are not enrollment, grades, academic credit, continuing-education credit, certificates, badges, licenses, or independently verified credentials.

policySections.title: Register, review, and correction
paragraphs: The machine-readable register at /api/institutional-credentials-register.json records selected public claim families and their evidence boundaries. It is not a complete résumé or background investigation. A status change, conflicting source, stale review, correction report, or copy change reopens the claim. Possible errors may be reported through the Corrections route.

evidence: Person-specific, program-existence, and corroboration evidence classes kept distinct
A release-blocking inventory and exact-claim evaluator
methodology: Inventory public credential and affiliation language
Normalize variants to a bounded exact claim
Record evidence class, status, date, owner, and change trigger
Remove or qualify language broader than the evidence
assumptions: Public corroboration pages accurately reproduce their publisher's current text
The deployed site matches the evaluated repository tree
limitations: Private institutional records are not exposed in this repository
The register does not independently verify identity, enrollment, graduation, employment, licensure, publication review method, or current institutional standing
External pages can change after retrieval
